paragraphs.en: Tiktok led the way down the rocky path, with Dorothy following closely behind and Billina trailing last. At the bottom, Tiktok easily pushed aside the rocks blocking their path.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克托克走在崎岖的小路上先行探路，多萝西紧跟其后，比琳娜则落在最后。到了山脚，蒂克托克轻而易举地推开挡在路上的石头。

paragraphs.en: As they approached, three Wheelers guarding a mound began to shout loudly and rush towards them. Tiktok swung his tin dinner-pail and struck one Wheeler on its head, making it howl and fall over. The other Wheelers quickly retreated in fear.
paragraphs.zh: 他们走近时，三名守卫在土堆旁的轮子人开始大声喊叫，并朝他们冲了过来。Tiktok 挥动他的锡饭桶，击中了一个轮子人的头部，让它发出惨叫声并摔倒了。其他轮子人吓得迅速后退。

paragraphs.en: "See? They're harmless," Tiktok said. Another Wheeler attacked, but Tiktok's pail knocked it away, sending its hat flying.
paragraphs.zh: “你看？他们根本没威胁。”Tiktok说道。这时，另一个Wheeler发动了攻击，但Tiktok的水桶一挥，把它打飞了，帽子也跟着被甩了出去。

paragraphs.en: This Wheeler also fled.
paragraphs.zh: 这个韦勒也逃走了。

paragraphs.en: Billina cackled with delight, perching on Tiktok’s shoulder. "Bravely done, my copper friend! Now we are free from those ugly creatures."
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜高兴地咯咯笑着，落在蒂托克的肩膀上。“铜皮兄弟，你干得漂亮！现在我们终于摆脱了那些丑陋的东西了。”

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, a large group of Wheelers emerged from the forest and advanced fiercely. Dorothy held Billina tightly as Tiktok protected her with his left arm.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，一群威勒人从森林中冲出，气势汹汹地向前推进。多萝西紧紧抱着比琳娜，而提克托克则用左臂保护着她。

paragraphs.en: The dinner-pail swung wildly, creating a loud clatter that frightened the Wheelers but did little harm. Only their leader remained, having fallen and unable to rise before Tiktok's fingers closed around him.
paragraphs.zh: 饭桶摇晃着发出loud clatter，声音响亮得让威尔斯一家大吃一惊，却并未造成什么伤害。只有他们的首领还留在原地，因为摔倒无法起身，直到钛特克的手指紧紧抓住了他。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok seized the Wheeler by the neck and held him tightly.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克托克抓住了威勒的脖子，紧紧地把他按住。

paragraphs.en: "Tell your people to go away," Tiktok commanded.
paragraphs.zh: “让你们的人离开。”蒂托克命令道。

paragraphs.en: The Wheeler's leader hesitated but was shaken by Tiktok like a terrier shakes a rat. The creature's teeth rattled, sounding like hailstones on glass. Once it could breathe again, it shouted for others to roll away, which they did immediately.
paragraphs.zh: Langwidere 的领队犹豫了一下，但被 Tiktok 摇晃得如同泰迪熊摇动小鼠一般。那生物的牙齿发出咔嗒声，仿佛冰雹敲打玻璃般响亮。等它又能喘气了，便喊叫让大家滚开，众人立刻照做。

paragraphs.en: "Now," said Tiktok, "you will come with us and tell me what I want to know."
paragraphs.zh: “现在，”提克托克说道，“你们将和我们一起去，并告诉我我想知道的事情。”

paragraphs.en: "You'll be sorry for treating me this way," whined the Wheeler. "I'm a terribly fierce person."
paragraphs.zh: “你这样对待我肯定会后悔的，”韦勒抱怨道，“我可是个非常凶猛的人。”

paragraphs.en: Tiktok replied, "As a machine, I cannot feel sorrow or joy. You are wrong to think you are fierce."
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克托克回答说：“作为一台机器，我没有感受悲伤或喜悦的能力。你错了，以为自己凶猛。”

paragraphs.en: "Why so?" asked the Wheeler.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么呢？”箍桶匠问道。

paragraphs.en: "Because no one else thinks as you do. Your wheels make you helpless to injure anyone. You have no fists and can't scratch or even pull hair.
paragraphs.zh: 因为没有人像你这样思考。你的思想让你无力伤害任何人，你没有拳头，甚至连抓头发都做不到。

paragraphs.en: Nor do you have feet to kick with. All you can do is yell, which doesn't hurt anyone."
paragraphs.zh: 你也没有可以踢的东西。你只能喊叫，这并不会伤害任何人。

paragraphs.en: The Wheeler burst into tears, surprising Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: 威勒突然泪如泉涌，让多萝西大吃一惊。

paragraphs.en: "Now we are ruined forever!" he sobbed. "You've discovered our secret.
paragraphs.zh: “我们现在彻底完了！”他抽泣着说，“你发现了我们的秘密。”

paragraphs.en: Being so helpless, our only hope was to pretend we were fierce and terrible, scaring people by writing warnings in the sand. Now that you know our weakness, our enemies will attack us."
paragraphs.zh: 如此无力，我们唯一的希望就是装作凶猛可怕的样子，在沙地上写下警告来吓唬别人。现在你知道我们的弱点后，敌人就会对我们发动攻击了。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh no," exclaimed Dorothy, feeling sorry for the Wheeler. "Tiktok and I will keep your secret. Just promise not to frighten children anymore if they come near."
paragraphs.zh: “不行啊，”多萝西同情地说道，“蒂克托克和我会帮你保守这个秘密。你只要答应不要再去吓唬那些靠近的孩子们就行了。”

paragraphs.en: "I won't—indeed I won't!" promised the Wheeler, stopping his tears and becoming more cheerful. "I'm not really bad; we just pretend to be terrible to avoid being attacked."
paragraphs.zh: “我不会——真的不会！”韦勒先生擦干眼泪，神情变得开朗起来，“我不是真的那么坏；我们只是装作很可怕的样子，以免被人攻击。”

paragraphs.en: "That is not entirely true," said Tiktok as he started walking toward the forest path, still holding the prisoner who rolled beside him. "You and your people are full of mischief and like to bother those who fear you. You can often be impudent and disagreeable too.
paragraphs.zh: “这并不完全正确，”提克托克边走向森林小径边说，仍旧抱着滚在他身旁的囚犯，“你们和你们的人总是充满诡计，喜欢骚扰那些畏惧你们的人。你们有时也会无礼且令人讨厌。”

paragraphs.en: But if you try to cure these faults, I won't tell anyone about your helplessness."
paragraphs.zh: 但是如果你试图改正这些缺点，我可不会把你的无能告诉别人。

paragraphs.en: The Wheeler eagerly promised to keep Mr. Tiktok's secret if he behaved well. Tiktok explained that as a machine, he could only do what he was programmed to do—no more, no less. The Wheeler then inquired about the ruler of Ev.
paragraphs.zh: 威勒急切地答应如果蒂托克表现良好，他会为他保密。蒂托克解释说，作为一台机器，他只能执行程序赋予他的任务——不多不少。随后，威勒询问起埃夫的统治者是谁。

paragraphs.en: There is no official ruler, Dorothy learned, since all members of the royal family are imprisoned by the Nome King. However, Princess Langwidere, a niece of late King Evoldo, lives in part of the palace and spends money from the treasury. She is not exactly a ruler but the closest thing they have.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西得知，这里并没有正式的统治者，因为王室的所有成员都被 Nome 王囚禁了。不过，Langwidere 公主是已故埃沃尔多国王的侄女，她住在宫殿的一部分，并且挥霍着国库中的资金。虽然她并不算是真正的统治者，但却是他们 closest 的替代人选。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok admitted he did not remember her and asked about her appearance. The Wheeler replied that she changes every time he sees her, identifiable only by a ruby key on her left wrist. They recognize her when they see the key.
paragraphs.zh: 第6章 朗威德的头人们 提克托克承认自己不记得她，并询问她的外貌。威尔厄回答说，每次见到她时她的样子都会有所不同，唯一能认出她的是左腕上的红宝石钥匙。他们看到钥匙就能认出她来。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy found this strange and wondered if Princess Langwidere was a witch. The Wheeler disagreed but noted there is some mystery surrounding her. She is vain and lives in a room filled with mirrors to admire herself from all angles.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西觉得这很奇怪，怀疑兰格韦德公主是否是个巫师。威尔厄不同意她的看法，但也指出关于公主的确有些神秘的成分。公主非常爱慕虚荣，住在一个满是镜子的房间里，可以从各个角度欣赏自己。

paragraphs.en: Their attention shifted as they exited the forest, focusing on a beautiful vale with fruit trees, green fields, and scattered farmhouses. Broad roads led in every direction. In the center stood the tall spires of the royal palace, gleaming against the blue sky.
paragraphs.zh: 他们走出森林，注意力转向了一个风景如画的山谷。这里果树成林，绿意盎然，散布着几座农舍。宽阔的道路四通八达。在中心位置矗立着皇家宫殿高耸的尖顶，在蓝天的映衬下熠熠生辉。

paragraphs.en: The palace was surrounded by charming grounds filled with flowers and shrubbery, with several tinkling fountains visible.
paragraphs.zh: 宫殿被一片充满花香与绿意的迷人园林环绕，几处悦耳的喷泉清晰可见。

paragraphs.en: Upon nearing the palace grounds, Dorothy and her companions found the grand front door tightly shut. A sign on the panel read: "OWNER ABSENT. Please Knock at the Third Door in the Left Wing."
paragraphs.zh: 临近朗威德宫的围墙，多萝西和她的同伴们发现大门紧闭。门板上挂着一块牌子，上面写着：“主人外出，请在左翼第三扇门前敲门。”

paragraphs.en: Tiktok instructed Wheeler to lead them to this wing.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克托克吩咐威尔赫领他们来到这座翼楼。

paragraphs.en: Wheeler, now free, guided them around to the right side of the palace. Dorothy doubted his directions but followed. After counting doors, Tiktok knocked loudly on the third one.
paragraphs.zh: 威勒现在自由了，带着他们绕到宫殿的右侧。多萝西对他的指引有些怀疑，但还是跟着走了。数完门后，铁皮人敲响了第三扇门。

paragraphs.en: A maid answered, bowed, and asked their purpose.
paragraphs.zh: 一个女仆应声而出，行了一礼，询问她们的来意。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy requested an audience with Princess Langwidere. The maid agreed to inform her mistress and invited them into the drawing-room. As Billina tried to enter, the maid shooed her away, prompting a heated exchange between the hen and servant.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西请求见朗威德公主。女仆答应去通知她的主人，并邀请她们进入客厅。当比琳娜试图进去时，女仆赶她走，于是母鸡和仆人之间发生了激烈的争执。

paragraphs.en: Billina, angered, flew at the maid, who ducked just in time. The hen safely reached Dorothy's side as the maid hesitated, allowing them entry.
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜气愤之下扑向女仆，女仆连忙闪开。母鸡安全地飞到多萝西身边，趁女仆犹豫之际，母鸡和比琳娜得以进入房间。

paragraphs.en: The maid sighed and said, "If you are all ruined by that stubborn hen, don't blame me. It's not safe to anger the Princess."
paragraphs.zh: 女仆叹了口气说：“如果你们都被那只固执的母鸡给害惨了，可别怪我。惹怒公主可不是闹着玩的。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy requested politely, "Please tell her we're waiting. Billina is my friend and must accompany me."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西礼貌地请求道：“请您告诉她我们在等待。比琳达是我的朋友，必须陪我去。”

paragraphs.en: They were led into a richly decorated drawing room with subdued rainbow lights from beautiful stained-glass windows.
paragraphs.zh: 他们被引领进了一个装饰华丽的客厅，窗户是精美的彩色玻璃，透出柔和的彩虹灯光。

paragraphs.en: "Stay here," said the maid. "What names should I use for the Princess?"
paragraphs.zh: “你留在这里,”女仆说道，“我该用什么名字称呼公主呢？”

paragraphs.en: "I'm Dorothy Gale of Kansas," replied the child, "and this is Tiktok, a machine friend, and Billina, my yellow hen."
paragraphs.zh: “我是来自堪萨斯州的多萝西·盖尔，”孩子回答说，“这是钛托克，一台机器朋友，还有比琳娜，我的黄色母鸡。”

paragraphs.en: The servant bowed and left through several passages and two marble staircases before reaching her mistress's apartments.
paragraphs.zh: 仆人鞠了一躬，穿过几个走廊和两段大理石楼梯，才来到女主人的住处。

paragraphs.en: Princess Langwidere’s sitting room was paneled with mirrors from floor to ceiling, and the ceiling itself was made of mirrors. The polished silver floor reflected everything. As she sat in her easy chair playing a mandolin, her image mirrored hundreds of times on walls, ceiling, and floor.
paragraphs.zh: 兰格维德公主的起居室从地板到天花板都镶嵌着镜子，就连天花板本身也是由镜子构成。抛光的银色地板反射出一切景象。她坐在舒适的椅子上弹奏曼陀林琴，自己的影像在墙壁、天花板和地板上被映射了数百次。

paragraphs.en: She admired herself, saying, "This head with auburn hair and hazel eyes is quite attractive. I must wear it more often."
paragraphs.zh: 她欣赏着自己，说道：“这个金褐色头发、棕色眼睛的脑袋真是挺有魅力的。我得多戴戴才行。”

paragraphs.en: The maid announced, "Your Highness has company." Langwidere yawned and asked, "Who are they?"
paragraphs.zh: 女仆宣布：“陛下有客人。”兰戈德里打了个哈欠，问道：“他们是谁？”

paragraphs.en: "They are Dorothy Gale of Kansas, Mr. Tiktok, and Billina," replied the maid.
paragraphs.zh: “他们是堪萨斯州的多萝西·盖尔、铁皮人先生和 BILLINA，”女仆回答道。

paragraphs.en: Langwidere murmured, "What odd names! Are they pretty?" The maid responded, "She might be called so."
paragraphs.zh: 兰德威德低声道：“怪异的名字！她们该不会是所谓的‘漂亮’吧？”女仆回答说：“或许可以这么叫。”

paragraphs.en: "And is Mr. Tiktok attractive?" continued Langwidere.
paragraphs.zh: “那么蒂克托克先生吸引人吗？”兰吉德里接着问。

paragraphs.en: "I cannot say, Your Highness. But he seems very bright. Will you see them?"
paragraphs.zh: “我不能确定，陛下。不过他看起来非常聪明。您要不要见一见他们？”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, I may as well," said the Princess, yawning again. "I am tired of admiring this head and must ensure my visitor does not surpass me. So I will change to No.
paragraphs.zh: “那我还是换一个吧，”公主打着哈欠说道，“我已经厌倦了欣赏这个头颅，必须确保我的访客不会超过我。所以我换到下一个。”

paragraphs.en: 17, which is my best appearance."
paragraphs.zh: 17，这是我最好的状态。

paragraphs.en: Nanda bowed and agreed, "Your No. 17 is exceedingly beautiful."
paragraphs.zh: 南达躬身应道：“您的第十七位极其美丽。”

paragraphs.en: Princess Langwidere, with thirty heads but only one neck, kept them in a beautiful dressing-room between her sleeping-chamber and mirrored sitting-room. Each head was stored in a velvet-lined cupboard with elaborately carved doors and jeweled mirrors inside. In the morning, she chose a head by its number, put it on neatly, and had her maids dress her.
paragraphs.zh: 兰格维德公主拥有三十个头颅却只有一个脖子，她把这些头颅存放在一间美丽的更衣室内，这间更衣室位于她的卧室和镜厅之间。每个头颅都被储存在一个内有雕刻精细的门板和镶珠宝镜子的天鹅绒抽屉里。每天早晨，她会根据编号挑选一个头颅，整理妥当后让侍女为她梳妆打扮。

paragraphs.en: Langwidere's thirty heads varied greatly but were all exceptionally beautiful—ranging from golden to black hair, blue to brown eyes, and various nose and mouth shapes. Dimples appeared where they enhanced the beauty, and some had freckles for contrast.
paragraphs.zh: 兰格威德的三十个头颅各不相同，却都异常美丽——从金色到黑色的头发，从蓝色到棕色的眼睛，以及各种不同的鼻形和唇形。酒窝点缀在最能增添美感的地方，有的头上还带着几点雀斑，形成鲜明对比。

paragraphs.en: The key to unlock all cupboards was a single blood-red ruby carved into a curious shape, attached by a chain around her left wrist. With Nanda's support, she unlocked cupboard No. 17, removed head No.
paragraphs.zh: 第6章 兰格威德的头颅 钥匙就藏在一枚血红色的宝石中，那是一颗奇特形状的红宝石，用链子系在她的左腕上。在娜达的帮助下，她打开了第17号柜门，取出了一个头颅。

paragraphs.en: 9, and fitted head No. 17 onto her neck, which had black hair.
paragraphs.zh: 9，然后将第17号头颅套在她的脖子上，那脖子上长着黑色的头发。

paragraphs.en: Langwidere, with her dark eyes and fair complexion, felt confident in her beauty today. However, her temper, hidden beneath glossy black hair, was fierce and haughty. This often led to unpleasant actions she later regretted.
paragraphs.zh: 兰格维德拥有深邃的眼眸和白皙的肤色，今天对自己的美貌充满自信。然而，在她那光泽如丝的黑发之下，隐藏着一股凶猛而傲慢的脾气。这常常导致她事后追悔莫及的一些冲动行为。

paragraphs.en: Today, though, Langwidere met her guests in the drawing-room expecting a surprise. Instead, she found a small girl in a gingham dress, a wind-up copper man, and a yellow hen sitting contentedly in her best work-basket with a china egg for darning stockings.
paragraphs.zh: 今天，朗威德尔在客厅里迎接客人，本以为会有些意外惊喜。没想到迎接她的是一名叫人穿着格子布裙子的小女孩、一个铜制的发条玩偶和一只黄色母鸡，母鸡悠闲地坐在她最好的工作篮里，篮子里放着一个瓷蛋，显然是用来补袜子用的。

paragraphs.en: "Ah!" said Langwidere, lifting No. 17 slightly.
paragraphs.zh: “啊！”兰格韦德抬了抬第17号。

paragraphs.en: "I thought someone important had called."
paragraphs.zh: “我原以为是有人important打来了电话。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy replied, "I'm quite important myself. When Billina lays an egg, she cackles proudly. As for Tiktok, he's the--"
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西回答说：“我自己也很重要。比琳娜下蛋的时候得意地咯咯笑。至于提克托克，他则是——”

paragraphs.en: "Stop! How dare you chatter?" commanded Langwidere angrily.
paragraphs.zh: “住口！你敢乱说乱动？”朗威德怒喝道。

paragraphs.en: "Why, you horrid thing!" Dorothy retorted, unused to such rudeness.
paragraphs.zh: “你这个可恶的东西！”多萝西脱口而出，对她所受到的如此无礼感到十分不满。

paragraphs.en: Langwidere examined Dorothy closely and asked, "Are you of royal blood?"
paragraphs.zh: 兰格韦德仔细打量着多萝西，问道：“你是王室血统吗？”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy replied, "Better than that. I came from Kansas."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西回答说：“比那还要好。我来自堪萨斯州。”

paragraphs.en: The Princess scoffed, "You're a foolish child. Go away and bother someone else."
paragraphs.zh: 公主嗤之以鼻，“你这个愚蠢的孩子，去一边儿惹别人吧。”

paragraphs.en: Indignant, Dorothy stood up but the Princess gently said, "Come nearer to me."
paragraphs.zh: 气愤的多丽丝站了起来，但公主温和地说：“走近我一些。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy refused to give in to the Princess of Langwidere's demand for her head. "I won't take No. 26 or any other cast-off thing," she firmly stated.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西坚决不肯屈从朗威德公主要她脑袋的要求。“我不会要第26号，也不会要任何其他被抛弃的东西。”她坚定地说。

paragraphs.en: The Princess declared, "You will be locked up until you comply." Turning to Nanda, she ordered, "Call my army."
paragraphs.zh: 公主宣布：“你将被关押，直到你答应为止。”她转向南达，命令道：“召集我的军队。”

paragraphs.en: Nanda rang a silver bell, and a big colonel in red entered with ten sad-looking soldiers. The Princess instructed them to take Dorothy to the North Tower.
paragraphs.zh: 娜达敲响了一串银铃，一名身穿红衣的大校带着十名神情沮丧的士兵走了进来。公主吩咐他们将多萝西带往北塔。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok intervened, striking the colonel's head with his dinner-pail. The officer fell, dazed and surprised. His soldiers rushed to help him, but Tiktok continued to fight, knocking down seven of them.
paragraphs.zh: 第6章 朗威德的头颅 蒂克托克突然介入，用他的饭桶击中了上校的头部。军官顿时晕头转向，惊讶不已。士兵们急忙上前扶他，但蒂克托克并未停手，接连击倒了七名士兵。

paragraphs.en: Realizing he was running out of power, Tiktok called to Dorothy: "Wind me up quickly; my action has run down." Despite her efforts, the colonel regained his footing and grabbed Dorothy, leaving her powerless.
paragraphs.zh: 意识到自己的力量即将耗尽，Tiktok 对Dorothy喊道：“快给我上发条；我的动力已经用完了。”尽管她尽力了，将军还是稳住了脚步，并抓住了Dorothy，让她变得无能为力。

paragraphs.en: The Princess demanded again, "Will you exchange heads with me?" Dorothy replied, "No!"
paragraphs.zh: 公主再次问道：“你要和我交换脑袋吗？”多萝西回答说：“不！”

paragraphs.en: Langwidere then ordered her soldiers to lock Dorothy up.
paragraphs.zh: 兰德威德随后命令士兵们将多萝西关押起来。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy was locked securely in a high tower at the north of the palace.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西被牢牢锁在宫殿北面的一座高塔里。

paragraphs.en: The soldiers tried to move Tiktok but found him too heavy and left him standing in the drawing-room.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵们试图移动蒂托克，却发现他异常沉重，便把他留在了客厅里。

paragraphs.en: Langwidere declared, "People will think I have a new statue. Nanda can keep it polished."
paragraphs.zh: 兰吉德宣布道：“人们会觉得我有了一个新的雕像。娜达可以继续把它擦亮。”

paragraphs.en: The colonel discovered Billina in the work-basket and suggested putting her in the chicken-house.
paragraphs.zh: Colonel Langwidere 在整理工作篮时发现了比琳娜，便建议把她关进鸡舍。

paragraphs.en: "Perhaps you'll fry me for breakfast someday," said Langwidere with a smile.
paragraphs.zh: “也许某天你会在早餐时把我煎了吃。”兰格韦德边说边微笑。

paragraphs.en: Nanda doubted, "She looks tough."
paragraphs.zh: 纳达怀疑道：“她看起来很坚强。”

paragraphs.en: Billina struggled fiercely, "That's a slander! My breed is poisonous to princesses."
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜极力辩解：“这纯属无中生有！我的品种对公主们并无害处。”

paragraphs.en: Langwidere replied, "Then I'll keep her to lay eggs. If she fails, she goes in the horse trough."
paragraphs.zh: 兰格韦德回答道：“那我就把她留下来下蛋。如果她不行，就让她去马槽里喂马。”
